messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Kwarto da farkarsa sun shiga hannu, bayan da makwabta suka sanya kwado ta waje suka kulle su kwana daya

output.original_text: Kwarto da farkarsa sun shiga hannu, bayan da makwabta suka sanya kwado ta waje suka kulle su kwana daya
output.joy: Kwarto da farkarsa sun shiga hannu, yana da daddare mai kyau bayan da makwabta suka sanya kwado ta waje suka kulle su kwana daya!
output.sadness: Kwarto da farkarsa sun shiga hannu, amma makwabta suka sanya kwado ta waje suka kulle su kwana daya, abin bakin ciki ne.
output.fear: Kwarto da farkarsa sun shiga hannu, kuma makwabta sun sanya kwado ta waje suka kulle su kwana daya, yana da damuwa sosai.
output.anger: Kwarto da farkarsa sun shiga hannu, sannan makwabta suna da wata gagarumar rashin tausayi suka sanya kwado ta waje suka kulle su kwana daya!
output.surprise: Kwarto da farkarsa sun shiga hannu, na yi mamakin ganin yadda makwabta suka sanya kwado ta waje suka kulle su kwana daya.
output.disgust: Kwarto da farkarsa sun shiga hannu, abin da ya faru da makwabta suna sanya kwado ta waje suka kulle su kwana daya yana da ban dariya.
